name: Celesta
author: Frank Wen (FluidR3 GM SoundFont) / packaged for DAW
attribution: Celesta samples from the Fluid R3 GM SoundFont by Frank Wen (2000-2002, 2008) and Toby Smithe (2008), MIT license.
desc: Celesta (keyboard glockenspiel, hammered steel plates): soft, sweet music-box-like bell tone, 2 velocity layers. Range F#3-C8 (MIDI 54-108, best C4-C7). Lo-fi/hip-hop hooks, lullabies, fairy-tale and film cues, Christmas, doubling piano melodies. | Playable MIDI 48-108 (C3-C8), 2 velocity layers crossfaded. Params: pedal=1 lets notes ring until the next chord (sustain pedal, re-pedals on each new note); human 0-1 adds timing/level life; velcurve <1.6 = soft notes louder; bright = velocity opens tone; keytrack = high notes brighter.
